show.description:
Saanvi has fought for years to earn the title of Agasthiyo ki Devi, protector of the earth but the moment she achieves her dream, she divorces her simple, unremarkable husband Rishi. Hurt by his distance and absence, Saanvi convinces herself she no longer loves him and instead surrenders her heart to the mighty and mysterious Samrat of the Agasthi.
What she doesn’t know is the truth that binds her fate: Rishi and the Samrat are the same man. The husband she rejected is the very lover she now worships.
As secrets unfold, Rishi silently shields Saanvi from betrayal, lust, and enemies plotting her downfall. Bound by love but hidden behind a mask, he sacrifices his own happiness to protect the woman who wants nothing to do with him.
